scope: The complete standing Church of Saint Francis of Assisi in Ouro Preto, including the pale Rococo frontispiece, cylindrical belfries and the connected nave and chancel tiled roofs.

references.filename: Igreja São Francisco de Assis (Ouro Preto) a noite - 17-06-2023 - Ouro Preto - Minas Gerais - Brazil.jpg

originalReview.notes: The exact 2023 exterior shows the alternating pale plaster and mottled warm stone, cylindrical belfries set behind the undulating frontispiece, faceted domed roofs and pinnacles, arched bell openings, dark green divided shutters, and the relief portal and roundel.

quallaSearch.notes: Started with the published Qualla image ledger. The tourism photograph carried a mandatory individual credit alongside a public-domain mark and was excluded. Other local public-domain imagery showed a different subject. The creator of the exact 2023 exterior released their own photo under CC0 at upload; the first file revision, native bytes and creator agree.
